title: Decomposition of the biased linear score
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\in\mathbb R$, let $x$ be a point of the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The sum of the standardized biased signs of all coordinates of $x$ equals the standardized biased sign at coordinate $i$ plus the sum over all remaining coordinates.
